raw_html: [[The Artblade's Gift]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[The Artblade's Gift]]:''' You gain [[Legendary Concordant Opposition]]: Being struck in melee has a small chance to return some lost [[Hit Point]]s and [[Spell Point]]s to you. Offensive spells have a chance to grant 100 Temporary Spell Points. This has a one minute cooldown, which is shared with effects that grant Legendary Concordant Opposition.
